title: ID0467737-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003620] Charging issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Charging issue
Root cause: Plugin first gets autocharge authentication ongoing and fails
Solution: Remove Autocharge or teach the customer to authenticate with RFID first and then plug in.

additional_info.subject: ID0467737-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003620] Charging issue CRM:02681001253
additional_info.body:
Hello Cenoiu, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the session and found that:
The customer presented his RFID tag but since we also have Autocharge enabled.
It got rejected by the OCPP backend saying "invalid"
Not even 30sec later, he tries again but this time authenticating first with RFID which neglects the autocharge and it works.
In this situation, if you want Autocharge enabled, the customers that don't have this feature, must present the RFID card first before plugging in since the OCPP will always go for the autocharge first.
Please let me know if this information is enough and I can close the ticket or if I can remove the Autocharge.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
